name: window-reflection-beauty
image_vibe: Muted Portra reflection, layered city depth, quiet artistic realism
image_purpose: Create a layered documentary-style portrait using glass reflection and environmental depth.

prompt.project_info: A layered reflection portrait photographed through a glass window.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman partially obscured by the glass reflection, with the face and silhouette naturally integrated into the layered composition.
prompt.composition_elements: Reflection in glass window, layered city depth, subject partially obscured, documentary balance, and visual harmony between realism and artistic abstraction.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Natural diffused light, soft glass reflection blur, muted Portra color treatment, quiet urban atmosphere, and gentle depth separation.
prompt.technical_specs: Fujifilm GFX100S aesthetic, 80mm f/1.7 lens, 3:4 aspect ratio, muted Portra LUT, 60% realism and 40% artistic layered documentary imagery.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 3:4 layered documentary portrait through a glass window, featuring an original adult woman partially obscured by the reflection. Use a Fujifilm GFX100S aesthetic with an 80mm f/1.7 lens, natural diffused light, muted Portra LUT, glass reflection blur, layered city depth, and a visual balance of 60% realism and 40% artistic abstraction.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor or teen-coded subject, nudity, sexualized pose, distorted reflection, unreadable face, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed

assets.name: source window-reflection reference
assets.usage: Use only for glass reflection, layered city depth, camera treatment, and documentary mood; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the layered glass reflection, partial occlusion, Fujifilm GFX100S/80mm look, muted Portra palette, and documentary abstraction. Keep the subject original adult; city layers may vary.
